summary: METADATA-D 1.0.1 is published. Existing all-saved uploads are snapshots of prior outputs, not proof of a dedicated metadata Prepare assets action. Direct DungeonOptions/Weighting mapping and Windows refresh/rollback remain unverified.
surveyor_request: Use the METADATA-D panel's Prepare assets + upload action once and return its completion result and run manifest.
user_steps: Open the current Surveyor on Windows and click Check lane extensions.
Confirm METADATA-D 1.0.1 is active and select the metadata lane.
Click Prepare assets + upload and wait for Surveyor to report completion.
Return with the completion result and the new timestamped metadata prepare-assets folder or run manifest; if it fails, return the exact error text.
success_condition: Surveyor reports completion and GitHub contains a new timestamped metadata prepare-assets upload with its run manifest.
evidence_to_return: New timestamped metadata prepare-assets folder and run manifest
Surveyor completion result or exact error text
